name: Polytec Inc
old_description: The North Little Rock plant serves customers in our Southwest and Midwest regions.
about:
Polytec Inc was founded in 1994 by Jack Harmon in a small rental warehouse in downtown Mooresville, North Carolina. The company opened its first manufacturing facility and corporate headquarters in Mooresville in 2000, then expanded to three additional plants: North Little Rock, Arkansas (2010); Cartersville, Georgia (2017); and Chester, Virginia (2020). The business remains privately held under Harmon’s ownership.

Polytec manufactures a full line of water treatment chemicals, including dry polymers, NSF-approved alkali slurry products for pH and alkalinity control, and the PolyBac® line of bacterial and enzymatic formulations. It also operates as an OEM, fabricating, repairing, and servicing equipment such as pumps, mixers, and complete whitewater systems. Automation offerings include the proprietary Integrated Chemical Control (PICC) system, automatic batching and purging units, and SCADA integration. The company maintains over 40,000 square feet of warehouse space across its four facilities and a dedicated fleet of trucks for local and over-the-road delivery.

Customers span industrial and municipal sectors. Industrial clients include processors in the poultry, pork, and beef industries, while municipal accounts serve some of the Southeast’s largest cities. Polytec’s chemical programs address pretreatment and direct discharge permit requirements for both industrial wastewater and municipal freshwater systems.

The company’s stated mission is to deliver effective water treatment programs through quality service, products, and technology. Differentiators cited include same-day shipping on stocked orders, in-house OEM manufacturing and service of all equipment, a proprietary automation platform installed in hundreds of facilities, and a company-owned transportation network that ensures product quality through delivery.
